title: Omit dynamic statistics from auto-generated documentation
context: Documentation files included stale counts of Hunch records (249 decisions, 2 bugs, etc.) that diverged from reality when underlying data was corrected
decision: Remove dynamic statistics from committed documentation; direct readers to live hunch_* MCP tools as authoritative source instead
consequences: Committed docs no longer drift out of sync with actual Hunch state
Single source of truth for statistics is the live MCP tools, not static files
Reduced maintenance burden on documentation regeneration
alternatives_rejected: Keep counts with a 'may be stale' disclaimer (still creates confusion)
Manually update statistics each regeneration (high maintenance cost)
